rows.name: labels
rows.description: Confirm / cancel button text. Provide via confirmModalEnLabels or your translations.

rows.name: isOpen
rows.description: Whether the modal is open — you own this state.

rows.name: title
rows.description: Dialog title. Phrase as a question (e.g. 'Delete workflow?').

rows.description: Fired on cancel / close (X, Cancel, Esc, backdrop).

rows.name: isConfirming
rows.description: Show a loading state on the confirm button.
